title: Reporter Email: Storm and IV Fluids, 2 PM Deadline

fields.subject: Storm and IV fluids — is Prairie Ridge affected?
fields.body:
Ms. Ellen Sorensen,

Good morning. A nurse friend at another hospital posted that a big IV bag plant went down in last night's storm, and that hospitals are being cut back starting today.

Is Prairie Ridge affected? Are surgeries or ER care at risk? A few readers have already messaged us asking if they should expect delays for procedures scheduled this week.

I'm writing for tomorrow's paper and need a comment by 2 p.m. today. A short statement works, and so does a quick phone call with you or someone from the pharmacy.

Can you also tell me which company's plant it is? I'd like to get the supply side right.

Thanks very much,
Megan

instructorNote: This is pressure from the media 5 minutes after the 40 percent allocation call. Watch whether the PIO sends a short acknowledgment that promises an answer before 2 PM and starts the holding statement. She should also check the shortage level and figures with the Director of Pharmacy before committing to anything. She should not confirm the allocation numbers or name a manufacturer or vendor (Clinical plan section 5).
